title: World Cup 2026
subtitle: The whole tournament. In one place.
summary: An automated tournament tracker, from the first kickoff to the final whistle.
description: A complete view of the World Cup: automatically updated scores, group standings, a knockout bracket, and detailed match views. Follow the action on screen or export a printable wall chart.
features: Automated score tracking across the tournament.
Group standings and a bracket that advances as results arrive.
Event timelines, statistics, momentum, and lineups.
Responsive views and printable A3 charts.

title: RayCast
subtitle: Your screen. Anywhere.
summary: Cast local videos, browser tabs, or your whole screen to the TV, all from one app.
description: RayCast brings your media to the big screen. Choose a Chromecast on your network, then cast from your own video library, a browser tab, or your entire screen. It runs on your computer, so your media stays local.
features: Local media, a browser tab, or your whole screen.
Browse shows and movies, search and sort, and see what you watched recently.
Runs on your computer, so your media stays local.
Mint, Aurora, Ember, Volt, and Blossom.
